inlines.v: FLEX'UOUS, adjective [Latin flexuosus.] 1. Winding; having turns or windings; as a flexuous rivulet. 2. Bending; winding; wavering; not steady; as a flexuous flame. 3. In botany, bending or bent; changing its direction in a curve, from joint to joint, from bud to bud, or from flower to flower.
